India vs New Zealand T20I: Phillips Stars in Record Innings

In the first T20 International between India and New Zealand, Glenn Phillips scored 82 runs off 40 balls, contributing to a record innings for New Zealand against India. Despite New Zealand's strong start, Indian bowlers managed to restrict them to 225 runs.
